title: Heuristic outlier lab notes — quick scratch
body:
Purpose:
- Quick personal scratchpad for a set of oddball outputs found during nightly micro-batches.
- Capture ad-hoc rubric ideas, sample diffs, and immediate hypotheses before formalizing.

Context / trigger:
- Nightly run of sample-batcher against prod workload (sample seed batch).
- Compare model v1.4 (prod) vs v1.5-candidate on dedicated-reserve.
- Observed a cluster of outputs flagged by heuristic filters: repetition > 3, tone shift, hallucinated date facts.

Quick summary of observations (raw-first pass):
- Cluster A: conversational loops where model repeats a phrase with minor synonym changes. v1.5 worse on longer prompts (>220 tokens).
- Cluster B: confident-sounding fabricated dates for company events (e.g., "Redwood announced X on March 14, 2020") — occurs when prompt asks for timeline and model does partial recall.
- Cluster C: terse answers with missing constraints ignored (e.g., user asked to keep answer <50 words; model produced 80–120 words on ~12% of samples).

Ad-hoc rubric (prototype) — each sample scored 0..3 where 3 is good:
- Correctness: 0 (wrong), 1 (partially wrong), 2 (mostly correct), 3 (accurate)
- Fidelity to instruction (length/format): 0..3
- Hallucination severity: 0 (severe), 1 (minor), 2 (none but risky), 3 (clean)
- Repetition / verbosity penalty: 0..3 (3 = concise)
- Overall user harm risk: 0..3 (conservative)

Hypothesis matrix (what might be causing regressions):
- Quantization kernel swap in v1.5: new kernels for attention might change mixing behavior for long contexts -> repetition loop.
- Sampling temperature/decoding defaults inadvertently changed in runtime config for dedicated fleet during canary (check autoset overrides).
- New prefix caching heuristics (batch-level cache) may be returning stale tokens for some sessions -> leads to repeated fragments.

Representative samples (redacted prompts + outputs):
1) Prompt (summary request): "Summarize the product announcement in two bullets, include release month."
   v1.4: "- Major update in March 2023; improved runtime. - Shipping in Q2, opt-in rollout." (length ok)
   v1.5: "- Major update in March 2023; improved runtime. - Shipping in Q2, opt-in rollout. - Major update in March 2023; improved runtime." (repeats)
   Notes: repetition fragment identical. Candidate: repetition start index often ~ end of first sentence.

2) Prompt (timeline): "Give a short timeline of Redwood Inference public launches."
   v1.4: "2019: proto; 2021: hosted API GA; 2022: Dedicated; 2024: Private beta."
   v1.5: "2019: proto; 2021: hosted API GA; 2022: Dedicated; 2024: Private beta announced on March 14, 2020."
   Notes: fabricated date inserted (March 14, 2020) — check training-data overlap and any new retrieval augmentation.

Quick manual scoring (10-sample spot check):
- v1.4: mean overall 2.6
- v1.5: mean overall 1.9 (drop concentrated in repetition/hallucination buckets)

Immediate checks to run (TODO list):
- [ ] Verify decoding params for canary cluster — compare temperature, top_p, repetition_penalty between deployments (INF-5423).
- [ ] Roll back new attention kernel flag in v1.5 on a single machine and re-run failing seed to isolate (GH PR #1289).
- [ ] Run deterministic seed comparisons (seed=42) across both models to check for stochasticity change.
- [ ] Run a short audit against retrieval/knowledge-augmentation layer for spurious date insertions.
- [ ] Add a quick post-filter that flags repeated bigrams/trigrams > 2 occurrences as a stopgap for nightly.

Annotation guidance for quick labelers (for small hires / contractors):
- Mark repetition when a contiguous fragment of 6+ tokens repeats verbatim at least once.
- Mark hallucination when the model asserts a verifiable fact (date/company action) that cannot be sourced in prompt or linked artifact. Use web check if ambiguous.
- For length constraints, measure token-based output vs requested limit; score as failure if >20% overshoot.

Notes from talk with Priya (11/08):
- Priya saw similar repetition on long-context synthesis tasks. Suggested instrumenting KV-cache hits metric and per-request kernel selection logs.
- Noah suggested a short AB test toggling the new batching cache (on/off) for 1k requests to measure delta.

Ideas / next experiments:
- Controlled micro-batch where we artificially extend context with a random noise token to see if repetition triggers earlier.
- Temporarily enforce ngram-blocking for n=3 on v1.5 to see regression mitigation. If that helps, likely decoding issue.
- Run eval set through metric: repeat_ratio = (# repeated trigrams) / total_trigrams and bake into nightly alert if > 0.03.

Loose thoughts (notes-to-self):
- Keep this doc short and iterate — useful as a handoff to SRE/infra to add logging.
- If we find decoding param drift, we need a release checklist entry: verify decoding + caching flags identical between canary and prod.

Links / quick refs:
- Slack thread where original samples posted: slack://channel/model-quality/pV2x9b3 (search: "odd repeats 11/07")
- Jira: INF-5423 (canary-run investigation)
- GH: PR 1289 (attention kernel changes)

End notes:
- This is a working scratchpad. Will convert to a structured triage doc (one-pager + reproducible test) if we see the same cluster in 24h.
- If anyone else finds similar oddities, drop samples in the thread or ping me directly — keep raw prompts + model config.

-- G.F.
